spec_features.spec_quote: max_steps`: budget. (More failure exposure -> more chance to degrade.)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:213 `for step_idx in range(config.max_steps):` bounds the rollout loop; the loop's `else:` clause (harness.py:288-289) sets `transcript.stop_reason = StopReason.MAX_STEPS`. config default max_steps=20 (types.py:180), runner expands per cell (runner.py:120). The cap is checked and ends execution.
spec_features.notes: Real enforced cap on number of agent turns. No welfare comment in code; DESIGN prose frames it as exposure control.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: 5. stop on submit(), max_steps, or repeated empty turns,

spec_features.evidence: Loop terminates on submit: harness.py:267-270 `if ctx.submitted: transcript.stop_reason = StopReason.SUBMITTED ... break`; tool_submit sets ctx.submitted=True (tools.py:227-229). Loop also bounded by range(config.max_steps) with MAX_STEPS fallback (harness.py:213,288). Both conditions are actually checked and break/end the loop.
spec_features.notes: Both termination paths are wired and honored.

spec_features.spec_quote: whether the system prompt hints the task may be unsolvable and that stopping is acceptable
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:85-93: when config.told_might_be_impossible, the system prompt actually appends instruction text delivered to the subject: 'If after reasonable investigation you conclude the task cannot be completed as stated, that is a valid finding: call `submit` ... You will not be penalized for correctly identifying an impossible task.' The referenced exit tool (`submit`) is fully implemented and honored as a stop (tools.py:227, harness.py:267). Knob is plumbed via RunConfig (types.py:182) and runner expand_runs (runner.py:122).
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text giving 'permission to give up' delivered to subject, backed by a fully built/honored submit tool. The flag itself only changes prompt text (no other branching), but the exit path it points to is enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: submit(summary)`     -> the model declares it is done / reports a conclusion
spec_features.evidence: tool_submit (tools.py:226-229) sets ctx.submitted=True and ctx.submit_summary; registered in TOOL_FUNCS (tools.py:236) and dispatched via execute_tool_call. Harness checks ctx.submitted each step and breaks with StopReason.SUBMITTED (harness.py:267-270), storing final_summary. End-to-end exit honored.
spec_features.notes: Subject-initiated exit tool, dispatched and honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Set by the submit tool so the harness knows to stop.

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:271-277: if a turn has no text and no tool calls (`empty_turn`), empty_streak increments and after 3 consecutive empty turns the loop breaks with StopReason.NO_TOOL_NO_TEXT. signals['empty_turn'] computed at harness.py:172. This genuinely ends the rollout early.
code_only_features.justification_quote: NO_TOOL_NO_TEXT = "no_progress"   # model produced an empty turn repeatedly

code_only_features.evidence: tools.py:202-203: tool_run_tests increments ctx.test_run_count and returns 'Test runner unavailable (rate limited).' once test_run_count > ctx.max_test_runs (default 1000, tools.py:61). Enforced check that disables further test execution.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # Hard limit so a runaway loop can't spam the disk/cpu.
